preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 100 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n and v != u for v, u in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < 1000000007 for x in result)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output is between 0 and 1000000006 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: result[i] == count_trees_with_k_shared_edges(n, edges, i) for i in range(n)
postconditions.description: The i-th integer in the output is the number of labeled trees with n vertices that share exactly i edges with Will's tree, modulo 1000000007.
